column1: # BARE-v2.baseline.tsv — the G-T5-BARE baseline for the 82 bare traces of the
# jenkins-markers/v2 corpus (bare = the sidecar's frozen `stamp_class` cell, studies/010 triage).
# claim this file supports and the RULED procedure by which any row here may move.
# ── WHAT THIS FILE CLAIMS, AND WHAT IT NO LONGER CLAIMS ───────────────────────────────────────
# 55 of the 82 rows are still the ORIGINAL PRE-CUT emission and carry the T5 purification's
# before/after null for those traces. 27 rows were RE-EMITTED from the CURRENT purified chain: 7
# on 2026-08-26 on the Founder's explicit ruling, and 26 on 2026-10-05 (6 of them among the 7, so
# 20 new) under the same procedure. Their "pre" side is GONE and NOT RECOMPUTABLE: the
# JenkinsStrategy that produced it is deleted, so a re-emission cannot restore the comparison — it
# re-freezes the current surface as a new baseline. For those 27 traces this file therefore proves
# "nothing has moved since the latest re-emission" and NOTHING about the purification itself.
# A whole-file green means: the bare surface is byte-identical to this file. It does NOT mean
# "the T5 purification moved nothing on the bare class" any more. Do not read the old promise off
# ── PROVENANCE, oldest first — a row here moved by RULING, never by drift ─────────────────────
# emitted 2026-07-30: all 82 rows. Source: the SHIPPED PRE-CUT chain (JenkinsStrategy live) at
#   2-run byte-identical at emit time. Corpus jenkins-markers/v2, REGISTRY pin ae5f19f1.
# re-emitted 2026-08-26: 7 rows, from the CURRENT purified chain at insight-canon 3858821 on
#   linux-gcc16-release, via the gate's own REBASELINE-ROW patch output. Same corpus, same
#   REGISTRY pin ae5f19f1, byte-attestation re-verified on all 82 traces in the same run.
#   AUTHORITY: the Founder's ruling of 2026-08-26. CONDITION MET: the movement (7 of 82) was
#   attributed CLOSED by causal experiment to two insight-canon commits — f6169f0 (2026-08-19,
#   6 traces: sv_take_until -> sv_take_until_or_none, which stopped a colon-less remainder
#   collapsing the message body onto `component` and leaving `content` empty) and fb2bfd5
#   (2026-08-18, 2 traces, 1 shared: TokenShape::has_separator gained the wrapper bytes, so a
#   hex run >= 16 wrapped in ( { < " ' now reaches embedded_identity) — and BOTH movements were
#   judged CORRECT defect repairs, so neither could be reverted to satisfy this file. The rows
# re-emitted 2026-10-05: 26 rows, from the CURRENT purified chain at insight-canon abd841f on
#   linux-gcc16-release, via the gate's own REBASELINE-ROW patch output (corpus-gates run
#   37285909951 at insight-canon ab6ffb2, reproduced row-for-row at ab6ffb2 and abd841f). Same
#   corpus, same REGISTRY pin ae5f19f1, byte-attestation re-verified on all 82 traces in the same
#   run. CONDITION MET: attributed CLOSED by causal experiment, one build per code commit from
#   7a20b19 (last green, 0 of 82 moved) to abd841f, with each trace's per-line template surface
#   diffed commit to commit: 325493d (DN-134.D1, rule S: a digit-leading core in a complete
#   wrapper shell takes rule 5's disposition, so `(1)`, `[2.1]`, `"5.15.0-164-generic",`,
#   `(2.35-0ubuntu3.8)` mask whole as their bare forms already did) moved all 26; a1e07d2
#   (DN-134.D2, rule K: a number behind `;` masks per segment) also moved
#   path after a declared `"` lead masks under its ephemeral root) also moved
#   No other commit moved a byte. Every moved line read against the three rules' masking.md
#   statements and golden rows and judged a CORRECT application of a ruled mask, so none can be
#   reverted to satisfy this file. The rows re-emitted are the 26 the patch named; the counts
#   columns are unchanged on 22 and distinct_templates falls by 2 to 4 on 4 (lines that differed
#   only in a shelled number now share a template).
# re-emitted 2026-10-06: 1 row, from the CURRENT purified chain at the W471 commit (the child of
#   insight-canon d9db026 that lands ADR-16.D15: a rule-K value masks over its number's extent, not to
#   its `;`-segment's end) on linux-clang21-libcxx-release, via the gate's own REBASELINE-ROW patch output. Same corpus,
#   same REGISTRY pin ae5f19f1. CONDITION MET: the movement was REGISTERED before the code
#   one line, produced_lines and distinct_templates unchanged) and measured so: 1 of 82 moved, 81
#   byte-identical, 52570/52570 lines, 22209/22209 templates; gcc16-release green on the same file.
#   The one line carries a bundle `Import-Package` header whose imported package names the K step
#   masked into `version=<*>`; ADR-16.D15 keeps them, judged a CORRECT repair of a false merge. The row
# re-emitted 2026-10-06: 5 rows, from the CURRENT purified chain at the W476 commit (the child of
#   insight-canon 245e93a that lands ADR-16.D15: the kv_value rule masks its value over the number's
#   extent through the one value disposition rule K reads, and keeps any other remainder literal behind
#   <*>) on linux-clang21-libcxx-release, via the gate's own REBASELINE-ROW patch output. Same corpus,
#   same REGISTRY pin ae5f19f1. CONDITION MET: the movement was REGISTERED before the code
#   rows byte for byte, produced_lines unchanged, distinct_templates 3802 -> 3803 and 3804 -> 3805 on
#   the two jenkins-test-harness traces) and measured so: 5 of 82 moved, 77 byte-identical. The moved
#   lines (1 + 1152 + 505 + 578 + 577 = 2813) are the registration's Jenkins v2 moved set: text behind
#   a kv_value number that the rule dropped (2733 of them predicted token by token by its model, 80 in
#   projected formats). ADR-16.D15 keeps that text, judged a CORRECT repair of a false merge on the
#   Founder's ruling of 2026-10-06 (DN-134.O6 option B). The rows re-emitted are
#   re-emitted rows (the three Camel rows on 2026-08-26, the two harness rows on 2026-10-05), so the
# re-emitted 2026-11-15: 3 rows, from the CURRENT purified chain at insight-canon 0fced23 (and at
#   0fced23 plus the uncommitted N294 tree, byte-identical surface on all 82 traces) on
#   linux-clang21-libcxx-release, via the gate's own REBASELINE-ROW patch output. Same corpus, same
#   REGISTRY pin ae5f19f1, byte-attestation re-verified on all 82 traces in the same run. CONDITION
#   MET: attributed CLOSED by causal experiment — 7561a9a (f7bba0d's parent) 0 of 82 moved, f7bba0d
#   (ADR-16.D17, DN-40.O4 built: the address rule claims IPv6 and colon-joined
#   hardware addresses whole, before the composites) 3 of 82 moved, every per-line template surface
#   at f7bba0d byte-identical to 0fced23's; DN-162.D13's `@` pre-gate trigger, reverted alone on the
#   N294 tree, moved none of the 82. 26 lines moved, produced_lines and distinct_templates unchanged
#   on all three: on each Camel trace one netty machine id (an 8-octet colon-joined hardware address)
#   that the composites had shredded into four masked and four literal octets now masks whole; on the
#   remoting trace 24 peer addresses `/0:0:0:0:0:0:0:0:<port>` mask their full-form IPv6 address to
#   `/<*>:<port>`, the shape mask_rules.golden's address-rule rows witness. Every moved line judged a
#   CORRECT application of ADR-16.D17's ruled mask, so none can be reverted to satisfy this file. The
#   re-emitted rows, so the 55 original rows are untouched.
# re-emitted 2026-11-16: 34 rows, from the CURRENT purified chain at insight-canon 7c0d701 on
#   linux-clang21-libcxx-release, via the gate's own REBASELINE-ROW patch output. Same corpus, same
#   REGISTRY pin ae5f19f1, byte-attestation re-verified on all 82 traces in the same run. CONDITION
#   MET: attributed CLOSED by causal experiment. The port G3 proves equal to the built masker on every
#   aligned line (coderoast-corpora 44144a0), run on each of the 82 traces at 5a2f0e3's rules and with
#   each rule alone, moves exactly the 34 traces the gate moved and none of the other 48, with the
#   same distinct-template change on each: DN-163.D3's opener alone moves 12 of them, DN-163.D9's
#   decline alone 5, the two together 15, and the two with DN-163.D8's normal-form arms 2; DN-163.D3's
#   tilde, DN-163.D2 and DN-163.D10 move none. 72 530 lines and 110 305 tokens move; distinct
#   templates over the 82 traces 142 764 -> 118 637 by the port's count; the largest, the two Brooklyn
#   PR traces (22 209 -> 7 252, 9 045 -> 4 352), are DN-163.D9's position counters reading as the
#   numbers they are. 184 merges, every one varying by values only, and 0 tokens lose a mask, with each
#   rule alone and all on (DN-163.O4's G1 and G2). Every moved line judged a CORRECT application of the
#   ruled masks, so none can be reverted to satisfy this file. The rows re-emitted are the 34 the patch
#   named (coderoast-corpora sift_assessment/n462/jenkins_bare/). Re-run after the patch: 0 of 82
#   moved; red-capability re-proved: one digest altered on a scratch copy of this file reds 1 of 82.
